module: Node "Road Properties" (repeat_instant). Gives the properties of a navgraph road segment defined by two nodes. Inputs: n1, n2 (node names), xnorm (hidden, 0.5 by default). Outputs: roadDir (normalized direction, takes one-way into account), length, width, drivability (0 to 1), speedLimit (m/s), lanesIncoming, lanesOutgoing, lanesTotal, isOneWay, isPrivate.
notes: Bug: if no link exists between n1 and n2 (link == nil), the code still reads link.inNode and raises an error.
The number of lanes is counted on the string link.lanes ("-" characters incoming, "+" outgoing).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Resets the cache of the two names.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the cache of the two names.

work.desc: If both nodes exist in map.getMap().nodes, recomputes (when the pair changes) length, drivability, speed limit, one-way, private road, number of lanes (counting "-" and "+" in link.lanes, "-+" by default) and direction; always recomputes the width (2 × radius interpolated according to xnorm).
